title: Gravity and Protocol Again
author: Sebastian Quintana
blurb: Emrys Iversen, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
